text:
jordan: Quick sync  demo-day fleet + marketplace listing finalization for H100/H200/B200, Gaudi, MI300. Need owners for SKU tags, staged image URIs, partner-only publish window, and SI installer mapping.
anya: I can own marketplace publish timing + privacy settings. Need SKU tag list from infra by EOD Fri.
matt: Infra will push images to staging but require exact `kernel_variant` and `quant` strings. Can partners paste the final SKU strings we should expose?
bob_nvidia: Nvidia will provide `h200-standard`, `h200-low-latency`, and `h100-legacy-compat`. Driver bundle name and sha will be posted tomorrow AM.
sara_amd: AMD: `mi300-throughput`, `mi300-costsave`. We'll supply firmware compat notes. Also confirming B200 variant names from Habana: `b200-gen1` and `b200-compat`.
leila: Marketing needs 1-line vendor blurbs and approved model display names by Mon noon to create preview assets.
raj_si: SI installers prefer immutable tags. Suggest `redwood/demo-YYYYMMDD/<model>` e.g. `redwood/demo-20260331/h200`. Avoid `latest`.
jordan: Agreed. Proposed canonical tag pattern: `redwood/demo-YYYYMMDD/<model>-<variant>` and fallback `redwood/compatible-demo-YYYYMMDD/<model>`. Good?
anya: Good. We'll publish the partner-only listing Tues 09:00 PT. Marketing preview link by Mon, internal-only.
matt: Infra plan: push images to `s3://redwood-staging/demos/` with tags per Raj. I'll add fields in the manifest: `model`, `kernel_variant`, `quant`, `driver_version`, `marketplace_sku`, `recommended_batch_size` and `sr_slos` (note: `sr_slos` is short for suggested response SLOs).
raj_si: Include `marketplace_sku` and `installer_mapping` so our deploy tool can choose correct container+kernel. `recommended_batch_size` is helpful.
bob_nvidia: We'll provide driver manifest with `driver_version` and `nvlibsha`. If anything slips we will flag it here.
sara_amd: Same from AMD; we'll post any driver or firmware slips ASAP.
deploy-bot: build 5012 succeeded for redwood/demo-20260331/h200 (sha: ffeedd) :white_check_mark:
jordan: Two decision points: 1) publish window confirmed as partner-private Tue 09:00 PT. 2) Fallback if MI300 or B200 driver bundles slip?
anya: Fallback plan: publish `redwood/compatible-demo-20260331/<model>` and mark perf as "compat-mode" in release notes, with vendor caveats. If driver slips impact functionality, we will delay public announcement but keep partner testing open.
bob_nvidia: Understood. We'll prioritize driver delivery but accept fallback. We'll notify here with exact bundle sha if changed.
sara_amd: Same. If we need to swap to compatible image, we'll provide a brief perf delta note.
leila: I'll prepare two announcement templates (internal partner-only + external) and the preview assets. Drafts by Mon EOD.
matt: Opening PR with manifest sample and installer mapping in ~60min. PR will include example `installer_map` that maps `marketplace_sku` -> `kernel_image_uri`.
raj_si: I'll validate the installer against the manifest once PR lands and report issues in the PR review.
jordan: Great. Please react to claim ownership for the items you stated. I'll compile a 1-pager checklist tomorrow: image tags, manifest sample, blurbs, publish window, fallback image, installer mapping. Thanks all :thumbsup:
